limitations: Per-process raw order retained. cwd is inherited at observed clone and changed on observed chdir; CLONE_FS cross-thread cwd changes need separate review.
-yy decoded paths bind observed fds; IPC/device/anonymous memory and unresolved records are not silently source inputs.
Read buffer abbreviation is not file-content coverage; stable source/cache hashes are from reverified copies, not proof every byte was read.
Generated/transient file final hashes cannot recover all historical contents.
Environment arrays are recorded at exec; no semantic variable-use proof.
Tracer loader/DSO activity precedes the child tree and is bound by static closure, not these traces.
Observed access is not semantic dependency; no universal or complete build-input authority assertion.
